what: Every line here was written by August. It is his. Nothing in this repository may reword, reformat, retitle or 'improve' any of it, including its spelling, its capitalisation, its punctuation and its spacing.
why: A writing gate that cannot tell whose words it is judging is worse than no gate, because it will confidently sand the voice off the one part of the product that has a voice. This file is how scripts/gates/slop.mjs knows to look away. Every value inside config/copy.json's `locked` block is also his and is skipped wholesale.
howToAdd: When August writes a line and it goes into the product, add it here in the same breath. A line that is his and is not listed here is a line a gate may one day rewrite.
